title.zh: 通往 E3 之路 · 第 3 天

subtitle.en: A productive day of mostly invisible work — collision and occluders — plus some new interior spaces.
subtitle.zh: 高产的一天，活儿大多花在看不见的地方——碰撞和遮挡物——外加几处新的内部空间。

translator.note: 原文 3 张图；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。原文里图片与后一句话连在同一段，译文按原顺序保留。

blocks.en: This was a very productive day but visually less noticeable.
blocks.zh: 这天的产出很高，但视觉上不太看得出来。

blocks.en: A lot of "invisible' stuff got done like collision and occluders to make the area decently playable:
blocks.zh: 做了很多「看不见」的东西，比如碰撞和遮挡物，好让这片区域能正常玩起来：

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/shot_2014.06.04__time_18_33_n03.png) The center building is now complete and we got the layout for the ruined walls so the major task for tomorrow is to get them all detailed (very time consuming!)
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）中央建筑现在完成了，废墟墙体的布局也定下来了，所以明天的主要任务就是给它们全都加上细节（非常耗时间！）

blocks.en: And finally some new interior spaces that you can't really see from the previous angles.
blocks.zh: 最后是一些从之前那些角度看不到的新内部空间。

blocks.en: Orsi is in charge of the vegetation (she is amazing at it) so that is one big chunk of work I don't have to worry about!
blocks.zh: 植被由 Orsi 负责（她做得非常棒），所以这一大块工作我不用操心！

blocks.en: I'll be aiming to have everything done by tomorrow so I can use Friday for polishing and any major issues that I might have missed.
blocks.zh: 我的目标是在明天把一切都做完，这样周五就能用来打磨，以及处理任何我可能漏掉的大问题。
